By repeating these 12 blocks 3 times, we obtain 36 blocks. Each point will appear in 4 * 3 = 12 blocks, each block will still contain 3 points, and every pair of points will appear in exactly 1 * 3 = 3 blocks, satisfying all the conditions for a BIBD(9, 3, 3).
